topics.topic: Whether the Portal may modify binary-store folders concurrently or after installation
questions: May the Portal change or replace binary-store folders concurrently with a deliverer write, or is the Portal also forbidden from changing folders after installation?

quotes:
The binary store is
   written only by the Portal and the deliverer, both installed by the owner; Syncthing and the calling
   agent have no access to it. No other actor changes its folders, so the containment checked before a
   write holds for that write.
judgement.why: The texts do not make the reviewer's folder-replacement event admissible: saying that the Portal writes the store does not say that it may replace its folders concurrently, nor does the passage explicitly forbid the Portal from doing so.
